scope: Local application integration with unmodified Commerce SDK and synthetic signed events; no Agentcard API, merchant order, charge or real inbox

cases.expected: Two deliveries to one worker yield one captured message
Concurrent first deliveries to two workers yield one captured message
An acknowledged completed event replayed after application restart yields one message
After HTTP acknowledgment and SIGKILL before sending, restart delivers the durable pending event without webhook redelivery
SIGKILL after independent sink commit but before application acknowledgment recovers with one message
Sink returns 503 once; the durably accepted event is retried to one message
Sink commits then drops the HTTP response; retry retains one captured message
SDK returns 400; no inbox or message effect
SDK returns 400 for signature timestamp 10 minutes old; no effect
SDK returns 200 but expired purchase message produces no inbox or message effect
Valid shopper/thread events go to their bound chats; mismatched binding produces no message
Same event ID with changed payload delivered to another worker does not alter or repeat first message
Unavailable application database yields SDK 500; restored database plus redelivery captures one message

limits: Notification uniqueness requires an idempotent downstream sink; no exactly-once promise for arbitrary email or chat APIs
No agent conversation, purchase authorization, price-change, merchant order or payment settlement verified
Synthetic event payloads follow pinned public SDK contract; not captured live provider fixtures
Local controlled mutation and repair; not an Agentcard defect report or native-agent acceptance
Configured bindings are test fixtures; not real OAuth or identity-provider acceptance
